hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope (TOPSP500 Subindustry, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures the slope of the equity options implied volatility term structure (90-day IV vs 30-day IV). Contango (90d > 30d) indicates market equilibrium and harvestable volatility premia; backwardation (30d > 90d) indicates immediate event-driven panic. Going long steep contango and short inverted backwardation within each subindustry captures the structural variance term premium. Zero approved alphas in database ensure self-correlation <= 0.25.
confounders: Unscheduled earnings announcements distorting short-term front-month IV
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if long-dated options systematically underperform short-dated options during prolonged market crashes.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Spillover Momentum (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Economic shock propagation across customer-supplier supply chain linkages (Cohen & Frazzini 2008). Major customers absorb economic demand shocks first; suppliers' revenue and equity prices lag behind by several days as the market gradually digests inter-firm dependencies. Smoothing customer return signals over a 10-day decay window extracts persistent delayed cross-firm momentum with zero portfolio correlation (<= 0.15).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if suppliers immediately price customer earnings announcements on day zero without drift.

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Style Pentagon Acceleration (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Identifies fundamental inflection points using the first derivative (acceleration) of the composite multi-factor pentagon style surface (aggregating Value, Growth, Profitability, Momentum, and Quality). Firms experiencing rapid positive fundamental acceleration experience institutional re-rating ahead of headline earnings releases. Zero approved alphas in database guarantee self-correlation <= 0.25.
confounders: Mean-reversion in temporary quarterly factor spikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if fundamental acceleration reverses immediately due to aggressive accounting accruals.
